title: Both exact open functors transport strict Roos completion and its unit
statement: Let e:V to W be a quasi-compact open immersion, with specified Operations o [def-sf-integral-open-operations], and assume its finite and completed coefficient maps are invertible. There is a unit-compatible natural isomorphism C_W followed by e* to e* followed by C_V, and a representative comparison from its restriction to good complexes to the strict pulled Roos tower. The representative comparison sends the actual unit to Q of the termwise restricted quotient augmentation followed by scalarRoosMap, in both normalized Roos coordinates [def-sf-additive-roos-map, def-sf-strict-roos-functor, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. There is likewise a unit-compatible natural isomorphism C_V followed by e! to e! followed by C_W. No completeness or adjunction conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Tags 099N (2),(5), 0941 and 09BN; normalized strict-tower comparison, including both augmentation coordinates.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives. Coefficient-compatible tensor restriction gives a simultaneous isomorphism of strict quotient towers, respecting transitions and augmentations. Restriction is exact and preserves countable products.

Apply the normalized exact-product strict-limit comparison and descend through the good-complex localization. Its augmentation equation gives rho. Before identifying the restricted quotient tower, the same construction yields c; its product comparisons on both summands are the specified scalarRoosMap.

Quasi-compact open extension preserves countable products. The simultaneous open semilinear tensor model gives the extension comparison of strict quotient towers, including transitions and augmentations. Apply the strict-limit comparison and descend to obtain sigma with its unit identity.

theorem openRoosFunctorTransport
    {V W : Scheme.{t}} (e : V ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E e)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (o.finiteMap n)) (hcompleted : IsIso o.completedMap) :
    (∃ rho : IntegralOnSlice.completion l E W none ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o ≅
        IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o ⋙ IntegralOnSlice.completion l E V none,
      (∀ H : IntegralOnSlice.D l E W none,
        (IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o).map
          ((IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E W none).app H) ≫ rho.hom.app H =
        (IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E V none).app
          ((IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o).obj H)) ∧
      ∃ c : IntegralOnSlice.qGood l E W none ⋙
          (IntegralOnSlice.completion l E W none ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o) ≅
        (IntegralOnSlice.Good l E W none).ι ⋙ IntegralOnSlice.tower l E W none ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj
            ((IntegralOpenReduction.restriction l E e o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
          integralOperationsRoosFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
        ∀ P : (IntegralOnSlice.Good l E W none).FullSubcategory,
          (IntegralOpenReduction.star l E e o).map
              ((IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E W none).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
              c.hom.app P =
            (IntegralOpenReduction.restriction l E e o).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P.obj ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map
                (((IntegralOpenReduction.restriction l E e o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
                  (IntegralOnSlice.roosUnit l E W none P.obj) ≫
                  scalarRoosMap (IntegralOpenReduction.restriction l E e o)
                    ((IntegralOnSlice.tower l E W none).obj P.obj))) ∧
    (∃ sigma : IntegralOnSlice.completion l E V none ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E e o ≅
        IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E e o ⋙ IntegralOnSlice.completion l E W none,
      ∀ M : IntegralOnSlice.D l E V none,
        (IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E e o).map
          ((IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E V none).app M) ≫ sigma.hom.app M =
        (IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E W none).app
          ((IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E e o).obj M))
